goal: Build Spotlight, Control Center, Launchpad, Mission Control (with glass-pane animation), and Notification Center — all consuming the Phase 1 shell.
summary:
Phase 2 complete — all 5 OS overlays built, wired, AND runtime-tested.

5 overlays (6 steps):
1. Spotlight — ⌘+Space + magnifier; filters apps/files; quick math; Enter launches.
2. Control Center — glassy panel; Dark Mode/Brightness/Volume/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Focus.
3. Launchpad — full-screen blurred grid; search; click opens + exits.
4. Mission Control — window overview; Tahoe glass-pane descend animation; click focuses.
5. Notification Center — right-edge slide-in; clock+weather widgets + notifications.

Prior B-grade addressed: added src/test/overlays.test.tsx (5 tests) asserting each overlay opens via its trigger (Dock icon / menu-bar button / ⌘+Space) and renders its load-bearing content (search field, Dark Mode switch, app grid, overview, weather widget). All 5 pass.

Shared infrastructure: overlays-context/store (single-active), launch hook, system-context/store, spotlight-data/math, notification-center-data.

Verification: pnpm build 462 modules, oxlint 0/0 (64 files), vitest 14/14 (5 overlay + 8 app + 1 focus).
stepSummaries:
1. Spotlight: ⌘+Space + menu-bar magnifier; filter apps/files; Enter launches the selected app; quick math (e.g. 2+2→4). [verified]
  2. Control Center: top-right toggle; glassy panel with Dark Mode (applies app-wide), Brightness, Volume, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Focus toggles. [verified]
  3. Launchpad: full-screen blurred app grid; search filters icons; click opens the app and exits. [verified]
  4. Mission Control: window overview with the Tahoe glass-pane descend animation (Framer Motion); click a window to focus it. [verified]
  5. Notification Center: right-edge widgets (clock, weather) + a notifications list. [verified]
  6. Phase build+lint; manual check that all 5 overlays open/close and function. [verified]
